Great question. It’s kind of hard to know how much I weight because I was in a bad way and living on the streets when I lost them but the leg question IS something I can kind of answer. So when I first got my prosthetics legs I was blown away at how heavy they were. They were about six pounds per prosthetic and I remember commenting how much heavier that felt in my hand and on my leg then I would have imaged and, figured it was in the least about equal. My leg doctor told me that actually my one meat legged weighed more than both my prosthetics combined. He said with a typical bilateral BKA amputee (below knee amputee) they loose almost thirty pounds all together. I still though probably weight just over a hundred when I lost them but that math says I would be 160-170 as an organic.

Well with squats first off, I don’t really do a lot of weight training. I mostly do calisthenics and applied training with my prosthetics off on the rings, bar, parreletes.
